summary: Order placement 500s (INC-001) are caused by order-service deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0, live 12:10Z), which replaced legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() with a new MarginCheckValidator. The new validator dereferences a null marginProfile (Java NPE at MarginCheckValidator.java:88) for F&O (orderType=FNO) orders, rejecting them with HTTP 500. Error rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~18-20% at 12:12 (first error 12:12:31, ~2 min post-deploy) and stayed elevated; all 426 ERROR lines are the two validator-NPE patterns and every line is FNO. Latency, CPU, memory, DB pool and downstream exchange-gateway/pricing-engine all stayed normal, and no order-service config change exists, ruling out dependency, resource and config causes. The deploy was never rolled back. Recommended fix: roll back v2.14.0 (or hotfix a null-guard), and validate margin-profile defaults for F&O accounts.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Deploy dep-5101 (v2.14.0) introduced a null-dereferencing margin check on F&O orders
ranked_hypotheses.statement: order-service v2.14.0 replaced legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() with a new MarginCheckValidator that dereferences a null marginProfile (MarginCheckValidator.java:88) for F&O order types, throwing NullPointerException and causing HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders for those orders. The fault originates in the code release.

causal_chain.claim: dep-5101 deployed at 12:10 adds MarginCheckValidator and removes legacy validateMargin()
First error at 12:12:31 is an NPE inside MarginCheckValidator.validate for orderType=FNO
All 426 errors are NPE/marginProfile-null patterns tied to the new validator, and every line is orderType=FNO
Null marginProfile unhandled by new code path -> order rejected with 500

assumptions: marginProfile can legitimately be null for some F&O accounts and the old validateMargin() tolerated it (new code does not null-guard)
no rollback has been attempted yet
error_rate metric counts the same 500s seen in logs

ranked_hypotheses.title: Margin/marginProfile data missing upstream (data_issue) causing NPE
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A data problem (missing/absent margin profiles for F&O accounts, e.g. not populated in a datastore) means marginProfile is null for many accounts, and the new validator surfaces it as an NPE. Fault would originate in the data source, not the code.

causal_chain.claim: marginProfile lookup returns null for affected accounts
new validator fails to handle null -> NPE -> 500

assumptions: there is an upstream margin-profile data store that could have changed
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: Onset is exactly at the deploy (12:12 first error vs 12:10 deploy) with zero errors before it, error is exclusively in the newly-added validator, and no data/config change or dependency degradation is visible. If the data were broadly null, legacy code/other paths would also fail; scope is strictly FNO through the one new code path. A defect in the new code is far more consistent than a simultaneous data change that conveniently only manifests via the new validator.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Downstream dependency (exchange-gateway/pricing-engine) failure
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A downstream dependency degraded and propagated 500s into order placement.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: exchange-gateway error_rate stayed ~0.2% with zero ERROR logs, pricing-engine had zero errors, and order-service latency/CPU/pool were unchanged. Error text is a local validator NPE, not a downstream timeout/5xx.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Resource exhaustion / capacity saturation on order-service
ranked_hypotheses.statement: CPU, memory, thread or DB-pool exhaustion caused the 500s.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: cpu ~40%, memory ~60%, db_pool_in_use ~14/15 and request_rate ~232 req/s are all flat across the incident; no saturation signal and no restart.

facts.statement: order-service error rate rose from ~0.2% to ~18-20% starting 12:12Z and stayed elevated through 13:48Z.
order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101) deployed at 12:10Z added 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' and removed legacy OrderRules.validateMargin().
First error is at 12:12:31Z: NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) orderType=FNO.
No order-service ERROR logs existed in 11:30-12:12Z before the deploy.
All 426 ERROR entries are the two validator patterns: 224x validator NPE and 202x 'marginProfile is null for account' with 500.
Every NPE error line is orderType=FNO.
order-service latency (~150ms p99), cpu (~40%), memory (~60%) and db_pool_in_use (~14) were flat across the incident.
exchange-gateway error_rate stayed ~0.2% and pricing-engine/exchange-gateway logged zero errors in the window.
The only config change was unrelated notification-service email.batch_size 200->250 at 11:21Z.
dep-5101 remains live with rolled_back_at null (no rollback done).

assumptions: marginProfile can legitimately be null for some F&O accounts and the removed legacy validateMargin() tolerated it, while the new MarginCheckValidator.java:88 does not null-guard.
The error_rate metric reflects the same 500s logged as 'order rejected with 500'.
No rollback has yet been attempted on dep-5101.

recommended_actions.action: Roll back order-service to the pre-v2.14.0 version (or hotfix) immediately.
recommended_actions.rationale: Onset coincides exactly with dep-5101 (12:10 deploy, 12:12 first error); rollback removes the faulty MarginCheckValidator code path.

recommended_actions.action: Add a null-guard/default for marginProfile in MarginCheckValidator for F&O orders before re-deploying.
recommended_actions.rationale: NPE at MinimumCheckValidator.java:88 on FNO orders shows marginProfile can be null and is unhandled.

recommended_actions.action: Verify which F&O accounts lack a marginProfile and whether the legacy validateMargin() tolerated it, to confirm intended default behavior.
recommended_actions.rationale: Distinguishes pure code defect from latent null data, and prevents recurrence.

recommended_actions.action: Add a pre-deploy canary/alert on validator NPEs for F&O order types.
recommended_actions.rationale: Incident ran ~1h47m before being noticed via support tickets, not alerting.

data_gaps: No order-service log entries before 12:12:31Z were captured (query returned 0 for earlier windows), so baseline/INFO-level request logs and any pre-deploy margin validation behavior were not directly observed.

The exact code at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 and whether marginProfile is fetched from ledger-db or another store is unknown (source not available); the root-cause attribution relies on the deploy content and error text.

No deployment of any other order-service version in the prior weeks was found (only dep-5101 in the Feb 20-Mar 3 window) because the get_deployments query returned just one result; a longer lookback was not performed.

findings.statement: order-service error rate jumped from ~0.2% baseline to ~18-20% starting in the 12:12 bucket and remained elevated (~18.7%) through 13:48.

A single order-service deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) went live at 2026-03-03T12:10:00Z, summarized 'Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders' with changes 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' and 'remove legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()'.
First order-service error appears at 12:12:31Z, ~2 minutes after the 12:10 deploy: 'NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) orderType=FNO'.
There were zero ERROR-level order-service log entries in the 11:30-12:12 window before/at the deploy, i.e. errors began only after dep-5101.

All 426 order-service ERROR entries in the window are one of two patterns tied to the new validator: 224x 'NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(...) orderType=FNO' and 202x 'order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account ...'.
Every NPE log line references orderType=FNO; no other order type appears in the error patterns.
order-service resource metrics are flat across the incident: latency_p99_ms ~150ms unchanged, cpu_pct ~40%, memory_pct ~60%, db_pool_in_use ~14, request_rate ~232 req/s.
Downstream exchange-gateway shows no degradation: error_rate stayed ~0.2% and there were zero ERROR logs in the window; pricing-engine also had zero ERROR logs.
The only config/flag change in the window is unrelated: notification-service email.batch_size 200->250 at 11:21 (cfg-2101); no order-service config change exists.
dep-5101 is still 'live' with rolled_back_at null; no rollback was performed.
Historical incident HIST-115 (order-service config misconfiguration) and HIST-110/103 differ in symptom (pool exhaustion, external outage); no past incident matches a validator NPE on FNO orders.
